correctness.rationale: The full-dimensional five-generator base is fixed and all \(a,b\ge0\) are quantified. Exact complete nonzero signed determinant multisets for four lists yield the four displayed volume formulae via the zonotope determinant-sum theorem. The algebraic defect expands to the global expression; substituting the exhaustive inequalities a,b<=1, a,b>=1, and mixed yields four branches, with boundary compatibility. Exact monotone quadratic root calculations establish both radical thresholds; the mixed inequality gives the curved threshold. Cartesian product with [0,1]^(d-4) preserves all four volumes. Independent stdlib rational determinant recomputation passed 144 pairs; finite tests are checks, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: A full-text comparison with Skorupinski finds only the isolated \(h=(1,-1,-1)\) counterexample; the closest published result is the distinct scalar ray \(s(1,-1,-1)\), changing all components proportionally. The present two independent normalized negative components, complete quadrant sign portrait and three exact directional boundaries are not stated or implied by the compared claims. The general determinant formula can compute each instance but is not itself this exact two-dimensional classification. Global Rayleigh and generator-count results address different quantifiers. Searches cannot establish absolute uniqueness, and the Fradelizi et al. source was abstract-only.

value.rationale: The directional perturbation cone with fixed positive first coordinate naturally has two independent degrees of freedom. A complete exact sign map is needed to understand whether the 2026 counterexample survives asymmetrical generator rotations, beyond an isolated point or a one-dimensional scale path. The result sharply identifies a two-dimensional violation region, two distinct radical q cutoffs, and a nonlinear imbalance boundary. This is a motivated geometric stability classification, not renaming, arbitrarily fixed small samples or a trivial numeric correction.
